changed: Buttons, menu rows, switches and checkboxes dim while pressed, so a tap on a phone is answered even where there is no hover.
Headings break into even lines, and paragraphs avoid leaving one word alone on the last line.
On a desktop, scrolling past the end of a page no longer bounces the top bar away from the edge.
On Windows and Linux, the space for the scrollbar is always kept, so a page too short to scroll shows an empty strip at its right edge.
fixed: Scrolling with a dialog open no longer moves the list behind it.
